verdict.rationale: Meta explicitly documents third-party hosting across major clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP, IBM, Oracle, Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) and community evidence corroborates Llama being offered as a first-class LLM option on AWS, Azure, and GCP, satisfying the multi-cloud/gateway consumption story. missing for 10: no explicit mention of OpenRouter-class aggregator support and no independent benchmark of API compatibility/parity across these hosted endpoints.
